ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85-90%) with low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edge boundaries and the central peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions across both lobes; low-intensity black pigment forms a continuous narrow band along the trailing edge and a vertical, mottled cluster at the basal center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous boundary; right lobe exhibits several deep jagged indentations (high-amplitude peaks/valleys) distal to the notch; both fluke tips show irregular, heavy erosion/topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge from the distal tips to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark-toned, high-contrast textured clusters visible at the extreme distal points of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned yellowish-tan linear pixel disruption extending diagonally from the central notch area into the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss/jaggedness at the right distal tip; one prominent diagonal tan-colored linear scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical column of low-intensity black mottled spots at the central basal junction.
